parameters.jsCode: const cb=$json.callback_query; const msg=$json.message; const from=cb?.from||msg?.from||{}; const data=String(cb?.data||''); const text=String(msg?.text||'').trim(); let action='UNKNOWN'; if(data==='role:man') action='ROLE_MAN'; else if(data==='role:woman') action='ROLE_WOMAN'; else if(data==='man_name:keep') action='MAN_NAME_KEEP'; else if(data==='man_name:change') action='MAN_NAME_CHANGE'; else if(data==='man_catalog:open') action='MAN_CATALOG'; else if(data==='man_preferences:open') action='MAN_PREFERENCES'; else if(text) action='TEXT'; return [{json:{telegram_id:String(from.id||''),telegram_first_name:String(from.first_name||'').trim(),username:String(from.username||''),chat_id:String(cb?.message?.chat?.id||msg?.chat?.id||from.id||''),callback_query_id:String(cb?.id||''),action,text}}];

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::bigint telegram_id,$2::text action,NULLIF(btrim($3::text),'') first_name,NULLIF(btrim($4::text),'') answer),
account AS (SELECT ta.user_id FROM telegram_accounts ta,input WHERE ta.telegram_id=input.telegram_id LIMIT 1),
locked AS (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(user_id::text)) FROM account),
role_update AS (UPDATE users u SET role=CASE input.action WHEN 'ROLE_MAN' THEN 'man' WHEN 'ROLE_WOMAN' THEN 'woman' ELSE u.role END,updated_at=now() FROM input,account,locked WHERE u.id=account.user_id RETURNING u.id,u.role),
context_seed AS (INSERT INTO male_search_context(user_id) SELECT role_update.id FROM role_update WHERE role_update.role='man' ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id),
name_update AS (UPDATE male_search_context c SET name=CASE WHEN input.action='MAN_NAME_KEEP' THEN input.first_name WHEN input.action='TEXT' AND c.name IS NULL THEN input.answer ELSE c.name END,name_source=CASE WHEN input.action='MAN_NAME_KEEP' THEN 'TELEGRAM_CONFIRMED' WHEN input.action='TEXT' AND c.name IS NULL THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE c.name_source END,name_confirmed_at=CASE WHEN ((input.action IN ('MAN_NAME_KEEP','TEXT') AND c.name IS NULL) OR input.action='MAN_NAME_KEEP') THEN now() ELSE c.name_confirmed_at END,updated_at=now() FROM input,account WHERE c.user_id=account.user_id AND ((input.action='MAN_NAME_KEEP' AND input.first_name IS NOT NULL) OR (input.action='TEXT' AND c.name IS NULL AND input.answer IS NOT NULL)) RETURNING c.user_id),
city_update AS (UPDATE male_search_context c SET city=input.answer,city_normalized=normalize_city_name(input.answer),onboarding_status='COMPLETED',updated_at=now() FROM input,account WHERE c.user_id=account.user_id AND input.action='TEXT' AND c.name IS NOT NULL AND c.city IS NULL AND input.answer IS NOT NULL RETURNING c.user_id),
woman_profile AS (INSERT INTO profiles(user_id,status) SELECT account.user_id,'DRAFT' FROM account,input WHERE input.action='ROLE_WOMAN' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id=account.user_id) RETURNING id,user_id),
woman_session AS (INSERT INTO profile_ai_sessions(user_id,profile_id,current_step,ai_context,status) SELECT account.user_id,COALESCE((SELECT id FROM woman_profile),(SELECT id FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id=account.user_id ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1)),0,'{}'::jsonb,'IN_PROGRESS' FROM account,input WHERE input.action='ROLE_WOMAN' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profile_ai_sessions s WHERE s.user_id=account.user_id AND s.status='IN_PROGRESS') RETURNING id)
SELECT account.user_id::text,input.action,(SELECT id::text FROM woman_session LIMIT 1) woman_session_id FROM input JOIN account ON true;
SELECT u.id::text user_id,u.role,c.name,c.city,c.city_normalized,c.onboarding_status,$2::text action FROM users u LEFT JOIN male_search_context c ON c.user_id=u.id WHERE u.id=$1::uuid;

parameters.jsCode: const s=$json; const first=$('Normalize Telegram Event').item.json.telegram_first_name; let message='',reply_kind='PLAIN'; if(s.action==='UNKNOWN'){message='Неизвестная команда.';} else if(s.action==='ROLE_WOMAN'||s.role==='woman'){message='Продолжаем WOMAN-анкету в WF_03.';} else if(s.action==='MAN_CATALOG'){message='Открываем анкеты вашего города.';} else if(s.action==='MAN_PREFERENCES'){message='Открываем настройки предпочтений.';} else if(s.action==='MAN_NAME_CHANGE'){message='Как вас зовут?';} else if(!s.name&&first){message=`Ваше имя: ${first}`;reply_kind='NAME_CONFIRM';} else if(!s.name){message='Как вас зовут?';} else if(!s.city_normalized){message='В каком городе вы хотите смотреть анкеты?';} else {message='Настройте предпочтения или перейдите в каталог.';reply_kind='CATALOG_CHOICE';} return [{json:{...s,message,reply_kind}}];
